age.evidence: Twenty-three male Long-Evans rats between 4 and 9 months of age were used in this study.

sex.evidence: Twenty-three male Long-Evans rats between 4 and 9 months of age were used in this study.

dosing.doses_raw: high dose of LSD at 0.24 mg/kg (LSDhigh), a low dose of LSD at 0.06 mg/kg (LSDlow)
dosing.evidence: The drug condition for the second administration was the injection of a high dose of LSD at 0.24 mg/kg (LSDhigh), a low dose of LSD at 0.06 mg/kg (LSDlow)... subcutaneous injection of 0.5 mL saline.

assays.assay_description: Rats ran back and forth on a familiar 3.5 m C-shaped track for food rewards (condensed milk). PRE session (20-30 min) after saline; POST session (20-70 min) after LSD or control injection. Measures: lap rate, running speed, % immobility, head-twitch (HT) rate.

application_type.evidence: subcutaneous injection of 0.5 mL saline... followed by another administration of 0.5 mL under various drug conditions

setup_habituation.evidence: Animals were pre-trained to run back and forth (two trajectories) for food reward... The pre-training lasted for at least 4 days.

setup_restrain.evidence: freely moving rats running on the track

food_restriction.evidence: Each rat was individually housed, food-restricted with weight maintained at or above 85% of ad libitum level

time_to_assay.evidence: Fifteen minutes after the second drug administration, the animal performed the same task

sample_size.evidence: LSDhigh (n = 10), LSDlow (n = 3, except for G, which is n = 4), and the Ctrl (n = 14) conditions.

outcomes.summary: LSD dramatically reduced lap rate (~88%) and running speed (~54%), increased immobility (~34% higher), and induced head-twitches (~0.58/min) compared to PRE saline and controls. HT was abolished by 5HT2AR antagonist M100907.
outcomes.statistics: Lap rate p = 2.4e-4; speed p = 1.4e-10; immobility p = 0.017; HT rate p = 4.9e-4; LSD vs Ctrl lap rate p = 5.1e-5
outcomes.evidence: The median lap rate in POST under LSD ... was dramatically reduced ... HT rate in POST under LSD was significantly higher than that in PRE

B1_num_measures.evidence: lap rate, running speed, percentage of immobility time, and the number of head twitches

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Behavioural metrics reported as session totals/medians; no within-session time-course analysis.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural transitions or sequences.

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is excluded from ethological scoring per rubric; locomotor/immobility measures are not ethological.

B5_social.evidence: Focal animal ran alone on the track.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Familiar track running for food reward; no learning/memory test during recording. Cognitive map analysis was via place cell recording, not a behavioural learning readout.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Position tracked using two diodes via overhead camera; HTs visually identified or detected from EMG threshold. No pose-estimation/ML classifier.

E6_spatial.evidence: C-shaped linear track without separate compartments.

E7_social_context.evidence: Single rat on track during recording.

E8_food_water.evidence: ran for food rewards (condensed milk) on the track

D1_continuity.evidence: two track-running sessions (PRE and POST), separated by a sleep session

D2_session_duration.evidence: POST sessions lasted 20-70 minutes; longest 70 min exceeds 60 min threshold.

D3_recording_days.evidence: most of the rats (n = 14) only recorded 1 day per animal; PRE and POST occurred on the same day.

D4_baseline.evidence: PRE session with saline injection recorded before LSD administration in POST.

D5_followup.evidence: POST recording within same day, ~15 min after LSD injection.

D6_circadian.evidence: Longest session 70 min, well under 6 h.

judge_notes: All candidates identified a single behavioural assay (track running) — kept as one assay.
Excluded all electrophysiology, LFP, ripple, HVS, place cell, and MUA analyses per rubric (neural recordings, not behavioural assays).
B1 set to 4-6 (lap rate, running speed, % immobility, HT rate = 4 distinct measures) — agreeing with qwen and gptoss over glm.
B6 set to 0: although rats run on a familiar track (some memory required), the recording itself does not test learning/memory acquisition; aligned with glm/gptoss reasoning over qwen.
E8 = Yes because food rewards (condensed milk) are delivered on the track during the session.
D2 = 2 (61 min-6 h): POST sessions extended up to 70 min, which exceeds the 60-min cutoff.
D3 = 1: most rats recorded one day per animal with PRE+POST on the same calendar day.
food_restriction = 'before': chronic 85% body-weight maintenance is a pre-session restriction protocol.
setup_habituation = yes: ≥4 days of pre-training on the same track.
